To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a model of bacterial DNA synthesis and cell division is consistent with a wide range of experimental results.
the model of DNA replication proposed in ( 2,  7 ) is consistent with a variety of experimental data, and that the model may also be used to explain apparently inconsistent results.
the bacterial growth and division process is a complex, highly coordinated system, which has been successfully modeled using computer simulation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model which is consistent with experimental results, and the use of this model to simulate the growth and DNA synthesis of bacteria.
the development of a mathematical model for the growth and replication processes in bacteria, and the use of this model as a basis for computer simulation studies.
the development of a model of DNA replication, its coordination with cell growth and cell division, and the simulation of this model by computer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this model is a plausible one, and is capable of simulating the experimental results.
the model of DNA replication presented here is consistent with the available data and is therefore an acceptable description of the replication process.
the model provides a consistent explanation of a number of experimental observations, but does not exclude other explanations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a model of DNA replication can be formulated in which DNA synthesis occurs at a constant rate, and the cell division cycle is coordinated with DNA replication in a manner which allows the cell cycle to be completed within one generation time.
the model is internally consistent, and that the experimental results which have been used as tests for the model are also internally consistent with the model.
our model is consistent with all the experimental data that we have examined and that the model is capable of simulating a wide range of experimental conditions and results.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a computer program may be a valuable aid in the analysis of experimental results.
the model provides a framework for understanding how DNA synthesis, cell division, cell size, and cell cycle length are coordinated in bacteria.
the model provides a framework for the study of bacterial growth, and that computer simulation is a valuable tool for this study.
